mechanism_claims.claim_text: GW18 is a designed cathelicidin-BF analog with C-terminal amidation and predicted amphipathic helix/physicochemical features; this is design and structure-prediction evidence, not a direct molecular mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct membrane permeabilization or target-binding assay is reported for GW18 in the local source materials.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: GW18 shows rapid bactericidal activity against S. aureus and MRSA-Z in time-kill assays at 1x, 5x, and 10x MIC, supporting direct antibacterial effect but not a resolved molecular target.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GW18 against Staphylococcus aureus and MRSA-Z
mechanism_claims.limitations: Time-kill data establish bactericidal activity; mechanism of killing remains inferred/contextual.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Discussion links tryptophan and cationic residues to bacterial membrane interaction as design rationale; this is literature-supported mechanism context and must not be promoted to direct mechanism for this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No paper-local membrane permeabilization, microscopy, lipid-binding, or nucleic-acid interaction assay was recovered.
